items.name: St. Ansgar 2026

venue.name: South Square

items.information:
This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association (MCA)](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdVJjIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ebb5ac88c8992eb66bf5c48297c786ea7e990ec1/image.png)

Follow [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing) for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.

There are also two local Facebook groups that support the communities surroundnig the St. Ansgar area: 

* [Iowa Cubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1629559883761917)
* [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480)

items.name: Skowhegan Puzzlefest 2026
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa3hrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ae8bf56bdf7df2a9ddef232b67ef1762d8b05535/logo_200x200.png)

This competition is organized by Cube New England, a non-profit organization dedicated to the growth of speedcubing in New England.

* [Visit our **webpage**](https://www.cubenewengland.com)
* [See our **upcoming competitions**](https://www.cubenewengland.com/competitions)
* [Follow us on **Facebook**](https://facebook.com/cubenewengland)
* [Join our **Facebook community**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/402975042172435)
* [Join our Facebook community for **parents**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/732527678812618)
* [Join our **Discord**](https://discord.gg/3mX6xKUdRC)

Students & Staff of MSAD 54 can compete in this competition free of charge.  After you have registered, please use your district-issued email address to email Tommy Chestnutt @ tchestnutt@msad54.org.  After confirming relationship with the district, your registration will be accepted.  All other registration requirements remain the same (competiiton limits, registration timeline, etc.).

items.name: Brockport Bash 2026
items.information:
All competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab.

**Due to the size of the venue we must STRICTLY enforce the 1 guest per competitor limit.**
